definitions.gloss: high volume; loud volume; full blast
definitions.explanation: A loud level of sound, typically from speakers, music, or electronic devices. Often implies the volume is excessively or notably loud.

examples.japanese: {大音量|だいおんりょう}で{音楽|おんがく}を{聴|き}く。
examples.english: I listen to music at high volume.

examples.japanese: {隣|となり}の{部屋|へや}から{大音量|だいおんりょう}のテレビの{音|おと}が{聞|き}こえる。
examples.english: I can hear the TV at loud volume from the next room.

examples.japanese: イヤホンで{大音量|だいおんりょう}の{音楽|おんがく}を{長時間|ちょうじかん}{聴|き}くと{耳|みみ}に{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: Listening to loud music through earphones for a long time is bad for your ears.

notes:
Composed of {大|だい} (large, great) and {音量|おんりょう} (volume, sound level). Often used with the particle で to indicate the manner of listening or playing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大音量|だいおんりょう}で{流|なが}す: to play (music) at high volume
- {大音量|だいおんりょう}で{鳴|な}る: to ring/sound loudly
- {大音量|だいおんりょう}の{音楽|おんがく}: loud music
- {大音量|だいおんりょう}で{再生|さいせい}する: to play back at high volume

OPPOSITE:
- {小音量|しょうおんりょう}: low volume

RELATED:
- {音量|おんりょう}: volume (sound level)
- {音量|おんりょう}を{上|あ}げる: to turn up the volume
- {音量|おんりょう}を{下|さ}げる: to turn down the volume
